chunks: And from him, from al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris, from his father, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from Ali ibn Miysar, from Ibn Sinan, who said:
I said to al-Rida (peace be upon him): 'What is for the one who visits your father?' He said, 'Paradise. So visit him.'

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (the title of Imam Musa al-Kadhim, the 7th Imam)
key_terms.زَارَ: Visited (referring to Ziyarah, the act of visiting shrines)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the father of Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (AS) explicitly identifies the 'father' as Imam al-Husayn (AS), confirming the specific spiritual merit of visiting the grandson of the Prophet. This concise report underscores the high status of *Ziyarat* in Shia piety, linking the physical act of visiting the shrine directly to the ultimate reward of Paradise, a concept deeply rooted in the tradition of the Ahl al-Bayt.
